voices.note: anonymous redactorial voice of this piska (20a.6-22a.12)
transmits Shmuel's rule (20a.6); asks R' Asi (21a.12)
teaches (תני) that there is no ikur in birds
Rav Asi of the Rav Huna chain (20a.8)
the mishna Rav Chisda cites (מלק בסכין), 20b.6
the first tanna of the כמשפט baraita (21a.15-21b.2) -- 'the Rabbis' of 21a.4
the first tanna and REBS together, as the holders of גמרי מליקה ממליקה (22a.12)

props.gloss_en: whatever is valid in slaughter is, correspondingly at the nape, valid in pinching; so what is invalid in slaughter is invalid in pinching
[the rule] serves to exclude ikur simanim (ripping out the simanim)
Rami bar Yechezkel: there is no [disqualification of] ikur simanim in a bird
Rav Pappa: it serves to exclude its head
what is 'its head'? the incline of its head: where he began at the incline of the head, diverted, and went on until he reached below
Rav Asi: if he diverted [and cut] a third and slaughtered two thirds -- it is invalid
Rav Acha b. Rava: Rami bar Yechezkel's teaching holds only for the one who says there is no slaughter of birds from the Torah
but for the one who says there is slaughter of birds from the Torah, there is ikur
Rav Ashi: on the contrary, the reverse is reasonable -- the no-ikur teaching fits the one who says there is slaughter of birds from the Torah
for 'from the Torah' one can say that this is how He taught him: that there is no ikur; and even for the one who says [a bird is] like an animal, as regards ikur let it not be like an animal
but for 'not from the Torah, only from the words of the scribes' -- from where do they learn it? from the animal; the whole matter is as the animal
Ravin bar Kisi: Rami bar Yechezkel's 'no ikur in a bird' was said only of pinching; in slaughter there is ikur
Ze'eiri: if the neck-bone was broken and most of the flesh with it -- it is nevela
the mishna: if he pinched with a knife, it renders garments impure [when] in the gullet
there [the knife does not purify] because it is not slaughter at all
Rav Huna: because he conceals [the knife]
Rava: because he presses
[Rav Huna] holds that drawing back and forth in pinching is valid
[Rava] would say: what is chalada? like a rat living in the foundations of houses, which is concealed; here it is exposed
does one stand and pinch a dead bird? -- one does not pinch what is already dead
Rava: there [in the bird burnt offering one goes on cutting] in order to fulfil the mitzva of separation
whatever invalidates slaughter invalidates separation, and whatever does not invalidate slaughter does not invalidate separation
rather say: whatever is [part] of slaughter is [part] of separation, and whatever is not of slaughter is not of separation
and so he does: he cuts the spine and the neck-bone without most of the flesh

the baraita: how is the bird sin offering pinched? he cuts spine and neck-bone without most of the flesh until he reaches gullet or windpipe; then he cuts one siman or its majority and most of the flesh with it -- and in the burnt offering two, or the majority of two
Shmuel: [a person whose] neck-bone was broken and most of the flesh with it -- imparts impurity in a tent
R' Yochanan: one who split him like a fish -- imparts impurity in a tent
R' Shmuel bar Yitzchak: and [split] from his back
Shmuel: if he made it a gistera -- nevela
R' Elazar: if the thigh was removed and its recess is evident -- nevela
Rava: whenever it lies down and appears lacking
the mishna: if their heads were severed, though they convulse -- they are impure, like a lizard's tail that convulses
Reish Lakish: actually severed
R' Mani: like the separation of the bird burnt offering
R' Yirmeya: like the separation per the Rabbis, and you do not disagree [with Reish Lakish], or per REBS, and you disagree?
R' Asi: like the separation of the bird burnt offering per REBS [the majority of two], and we disagree
the first tanna: 'and the second he shall make a burnt offering, according to the ordinance' (Lev 5:10) -- as the ordinance of the animal sin offering
when it says 'and he shall bring it', Scripture distinguished between the bird sin offering and the bird burnt offering
as the animal sin offering comes only from chullin, so the bird burnt offering comes only from chullin
and [is offered] by day -- so the bird burnt offering by day
and with his right hand -- so the bird burnt offering with his right hand
'and he shall pinch and burn' -- as in burning the head is by itself and the body by itself, so in pinching the head by itself and the body by itself
R' Yishmael: 'according to the ordinance' -- as the ordinance of the bird sin offering
as the bird sin offering is [pinched] adjacent to the nape, so the bird burnt offering adjacent to the nape
REBS: 'according to the ordinance' -- as the ordinance of the bird sin offering
as there he holds the head and the body and sprinkles, so here he holds the head and the body and sprinkles
the stam: what does he say? this is what he says: as there, while the head is attached to the body he sprinkles, so here
Rav Chisda: 'Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering which is his' -- of his own, not of the public's, not of tithe
RSbL: wherever 'finger' or 'priesthood' is said, it is only the right [hand]

objections.gloss_en: והאמר רבי ירמיה אמר שמואל: כל הכשר בשחיטה כנגדו בעורף כשר במליקה, הא פסול -- פסול! (amoraic-memra contradiction; kind svara under protest)

objections.gloss_en: אי קשיא לי הא קשיא לי: וכי מתה עומד ומולק? -- pinching breaks the neck-bone with most of the flesh before the simanim; on Ze'eiri the bird is then nevela

answered_by.gloss_en: מכל מקום קשיא! אמר רבא, אימא: וכן הוא עושה -- חותך שדרה ומפרקת בלא רוב בשר (= p_chotech_belo_rov_basar)

objections.gloss_en: ותקשי לך עולת העוף, דבעיא שני סימנין, וכי מתה עומד ומולק? -- after one siman the bird is slaughtered, yet the second is cut

answered_by.gloss_en: התם כדי לקיים בה מצות הבדלה (= p_havdala_olat_haof)

objections.gloss_en: אי הכי, עור נמי! -- if it is for separation, let the skin be cut too

answered_by.gloss_en: כל המעכב בשחיטה מעכב בהבדלה... (= p_kol_hameakev; Steinsaltz gives this answer to Abaye)

objections.gloss_en: והא מיעוט סימנין לרבנן, דלא מעכבי בשחיטה, ומעכבי בהבדלה! -- the minority of the simanim

answered_by.gloss_en: אלא אימא: כל שישנו בשחיטה ישנו בהבדלה... (= p_kol_sheyeshno)

objections.gloss_en: כי סליק רבי זירא, אשכחיה לרבי אמי... אמר ליה: וכי מתה עומד ומולק?

answered_by.gloss_en: אשתומם כשעה חדא, אמר ליה: אימא, כך הוא עושה -- חותך שדרה ומפרקת בלא רוב בשר (= p_chotech_belo_rov_basar)

objections.gloss_en: מני? אי רבנן -- הא אמרי שנים דוקא! אי כרבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון -- הא אמר רוב שנים! -- 'two or the majority of two' fits neither

answered_by.gloss_en: אימא: שנים -- לרבנן, רוב שנים -- לרבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון
ואיבעית אימא: הא והא רבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון, ומאי שנים -- שדומין לשנים

objections.gloss_en: ואם תאמר: אותו מעשה דעלי, מפרקת בלא רוב בשר הואי! -- yet he died

answered_by.gloss_en: זקנה שאני, דכתיב: ותשבר מפרקתו וימת כי זקן האיש וכבד (I Sam 4:18)

objections.gloss_en: אתה אומר כמשפט חטאת בהמה, או אינו אלא כמשפט חטאת העוף?

answered_by.gloss_en: כשהוא אומר והקריבו, חלק הכתוב בין חטאת העוף לעולת העוף, ומה אני מקיים כמשפט -- כמשפט חטאת בהמה (= p_tk_vehikrivo_chilek)

objections.gloss_en: אי מה להלן ברוב שנים, אף כאן ברוב שנים?

answered_by.gloss_en: תלמוד לומר ומלק והקטיר -- הראש בעצמו והגוף בעצמו (= p_tk_rosh_beatzmo)

objections.gloss_en: אי מה להלן מולק ואינו מבדיל בסימן אחד, אף כאן מולק ואינו מבדיל בסימן אחד?
אי מה להלן בסימן אחד, אף כאן בסימן אחד?

answered_by.gloss_en: כדי נסבה -- it was taken along incidentally

objections.gloss_en: ידו הימנית -- מדרבה בר בר חנה נפקא: כל מקום שנאמר אצבע או כהונה אינה אלא ימין

answered_by.gloss_en: ואידך: כהונה בעיא אצבע, אצבע לא בעיא כהונה
